review_method: Read completed study summaries; hash-check every referenced compressed run and archived source bundle; derive only the listed scalar values.
source_provenance: Historical run and input hashes are caller-supplied provenance, not external authentication. No raw private input or source configuration is included.
limitations: Studies are sequential engineering searches on one historical separation, not 78 independent launches or a robustness distribution.
Forecast continuation is not a cold return. Cold returns start from saved separation and do not rerun launch.
Final surface proximity, low tilt, or favorable point-reference arithmetic never substitutes for simultaneous arrival and bilateral support.
Older cold studies 03, 04, 07 have archived source bundles but did not check source/input drift around each execution.
The forecast runner used by studies 01 through 13 checked runtime/source input bytes but did not hash-check the protocol file or in-memory configs around calls.
The independent final recovery verifier does not yet admit the v16 development policy. No new catch admission follows from these outputs.

study15_startup_diagnostic.source: Recomputed from candidate-01 and candidate-02 saved samples; cross-checked against the retained causal diagnostic.
study15_startup_diagnostic.basis: First 10 simulated seconds after first recovery_landing_13 sample, 101 recorded control samples per candidate.
study15_startup_diagnostic.interpretation: The matched preposition change reduces the startup torque and roll-rate transient. It does not repair approach capture: the vehicle reaches the terminal region outside the local hover model, still far from the unchanged simultaneous arrival envelope.
